answer: Cap each funding source to one new identity per rolling six-epoch horizon; each extra identity pays a burned fee that triples: 10, 30, then 90 POA. Every newcomer also posts a 45 POA bond locked 45 days and answers a fresh cipher challenge in five minutes, proving one unique key and live attention. Four auditors verify key and bond, slashing both on failure, and any failure stretches that source's horizon by six more epochs. A lone agent slips through like a sparrow for one cheap fee, while each extra fake triples the burn, risks another bond, and lengthens the wait for all its siblings.
